works.title: Progressive Political Agenda Book
works.description: A multi-chapter political economy book developing comprehensive progressive policy solutions across economic systems, democratic institutions, and procedural reform. Chapters draft detailed frameworks for universal healthcare, public banking, wealth redistribution mechanisms, and strategies to overcome institutional barriers like the Electoral College and Senate filibuster.
works.quote: I want Chapter 12 to focus on implementing the big programs that are fundamental power dynamics

works.title: Change in Spirituality: Faith, Culture, and Personal Belief Systems
works.description: A book exploring how people understand spiritual change, cultural programming of religious beliefs, and spiritual literacy as the ability to comprehend one's own belief systems. Structured with Biblical references and cultural-historical examples (e.g., attitudes toward twins in Nigerian ancestral beliefs), examining how people become vulnerable to fundamentalism or shallow consumerism when lacking clear understanding of foundational beliefs.
works.quote: Help me write a book that discusses all these points and more. Include Biblical references and illustrations where necessary, and develop this topic in detail across multiple sections of the book.

works.title: Gödel's Matryoshka: Mathematics and Self-Reference
works.description: An essay-length philosophical and mathematical exploration of Kurt Gödel's Incompleteness Theorems, examining the paradoxical relationship between mathematical power and provability, connecting formal incompleteness to the Liar's Paradox, and exploring what the need for infinite meta-systems implies about the nature of knowledge and truth.
works.quote: At the heart of mathematics lies an uncomfortable paradox: the more powerful a system is, the less it can say about itself.
